# superset_dashboards (Data Source)

Lists the dashboards that match every filter that is set, for example every published dashboard to embed with `superset_dashboard_embedding`, or every dashboard of an owner. Without filters, every dashboard. The list is ordered by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every published dashboard that carries the "public" tag.
data "superset_dashboards" "public" {
  published = true
  tag       = "public"
}

resource "superset_dashboard_embedding" "public" {
  for_each = toset([for id in data.superset_dashboards.public.ids : tostring(id)])

  dashboard_id    = tonumber(each.key)
  allowed_domains = ["https://www.example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `owner_id` (Number) Keep the dashboards owned by the user with this id.
- `published` (Boolean) Keep the published dashboards (`true`) or the drafts (`false`).
- `tag` (String) Keep the dashboards that carry the tag with exactly this name.

### Read-Only

- `dashboards` (Attributes List) The dashboards that match. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dashboards))
- `ids` (List of Number) Identifiers of the dashboards, in the order of the list.

<a id="nestedatt--dashboards"></a>
### Nested Schema for `dashboards`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number) Numeric identifier of the dashboard.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard is published.
- `slug` (String) Slug of the dashboard; null when it has none.
- `status` (String) `published` or `draft`.
- `title` (String) Title of the dashboard.
- `url` (String) Path of the dashboard in Superset.
